subject: GPU capacity booking for pipeline pilots — Q3 planning
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 May 2028 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: GPU capacity booking for pipeline pilots — Q3 planning

Team —

Quick note ahead of tomorrow's weekly ops huddle: Acme Cloud signaled they'll want a two-week pilot kickoff in early July and are pushing for dedicated capacity (reserved). Sales (Jordan) expects an initial commit that could translate to ~320 A100 GPU-hours/week for the pilot (see attached forecast). We need to decide whether to:

- Reserve a small dedicated pool (12 x A100 equiv) for the two-week window and offer burst slots, or
- Commit on-demand capacity with guaranteed preemption policies and offer price protection.

Ask list:
1) Laura — rough feasibility + lead time to lock 12 GPUs for a July 8 start (including any infra tickets we should open).
2) Marcus — high-level cost delta (reserved vs burst) and impact on Q3 committed revenue recognition.
3) Soojin — runbook/Canary plan for routing fallback if we can't sustain full A100 pool.
4) Jordan — confirm the ask from Acme and whether they expect a formal capacity SLA for the pilot.

Attached: pipeline_forecast_q3.xlsx (sales numbers), capacity_sizing_table.csv (initial estimate).

If we can align this week we'll include a minimal commitment in the mutual action plan.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 May 2028 12:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: GPU capacity booking for pipeline pilots — Q3 planning

Karthik —

Short answer: feasible, but with caveats.

Sizing notes (very rough):
- 12 x A100-equivalent GPUs for a two-week pilot gives ~3360 GPU-hours (12 * 14 days * 24 hours / factoring maintenance ≈ 2800 usable hours). That aligns with Jordan's 320 GPU-hours/week estimate as long as load is stable.
- Lead time: 3–4 weeks to pin capacity for a dedicated pool (inventory check + infra ticket + allocation). If we want physical reservation in a specific region, add ~1 week.
- Operational overhead: we'll need a temporary autoscaler policy with burst slots (~+4 GPUs) and a KV-cache warmup window; add an infra runbook step.

Action items I can take if we commit this week:
- Open a reservation ticket for a 12-GPU pool (internal ticket infra-alloc-4287).
- Prepare a canary deploy plan (will coordinate with Soojin).
- Confirm geo placement — recommend us-west1 to match Acme latency needs.

Attachment: capacity_sizing_table.csv (updated with margin).

Laura
Sr. Manager, Infrastructure Capacity
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Emily Chen <emily@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 10 May 2028 16:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: GPU capacity booking for pipeline pilots — Q3 planning

Adding context from the customer side — Emily from Acme included.

Emily / Acme team —
Thanks for the call this morning. To be explicit: the pilot scope is 5M tokens/day (batch loads + interactive tests) for two weeks, with a follow-on evaluation for a production pilot in September. The ask we're giving Acme in the MAP is: dedicated pool for the pilot window with an SLA for availability (90% of pilot hours guaranteed) and a price credit if we miss that.

We haven't signed financials yet — this commitment helps convert them to a paid pilot. They expect a short (2–3 page) capacity addendum in the SOW.

Karthik — please include a conservative estimate in the MAP (we'll call it 12 GPUs reserved + 4 burst).

Emily — I'll follow up with a draft SOW addendum after infra confirms lead time.

Jordan
Enterprise AE
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 May 2028 13:47:00 -0000
Subject: Re: GPU capacity booking for pipeline pilots — Q3 planning

Quick finance POV:

Estimated cost impact for a 2-week reservation (12 A100-eq) vs on-demand burst: ~ $38k incremental gross run cost (modeling includes reserved pricing uplift + opportunity cost of holding capacity).
Revenue/Accounting: If we include a commitment in the MAP that triggers invoicing, we can recognize as committed ARR in Q3 depending on contract sig date; otherwise it's a pilot expense (service rev) and booked as one-off.

Questions for sales:
- Do we need to provide a credit schedule for SLA misses? If so, outline the credit % and threshold.
- Will Acme sign a minimal financial commitment (non-refundable deposit) to justify reservation?

If answers are yes, finance can approve the reservation expense and map it to deal ACME-PRD-2028-07 for Q3 forecasting. I'll prepare a short cost memo (cost_estimate_Q3.pdf) by EOD Friday.

Marcus
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Emily Chen <emily@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 12 May 2028 15:04:00 -0000
Subject: Re: GPU capacity booking for pipeline pilots — Q3 planning

Thanks all — good synthesis. Next steps I will drive this week:

1) Jordan: get a signed MAP addendum draft with either a refundable deposit or explicit SLA credit schedule — target May 16.
2) Laura & Soojin: open infra-alloc-4287 and attach the canary/runbook; confirm us-west1 reservation acceptance by May 18 so engineering can line up capacity.
3) Marcus: publish the cost memo (cost_estimate_Q3.pdf) and confirm accounting treatment for commit by May 17.

I'll mark this as high priority in tomorrow's planning huddle and loop back with a single-threaded owner once the ticket is open. If anyone needs me to escalate to VP operations or legal for the capacity addendum, ping me directly.

Karthik
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
